# PROJECT KNOWLEDGE BASE

**Generated:** 2026-06-03
**Project:** Andy.Lee's Hexo Blog — static tech/engineering blog at huaqianlee.github.io.

## QUICK START

```bash
npm run build       # hexo generate
npm run server      # hexo server → localhost:4000
npm run clean       # hexo clean (cache + public/)
npm run deploy      # generate + git push to huaqianlee.github.io (SSH deploy key)
hexo new post "Title"   # new post from scaffold
hexo new page "Name"    # new page from scaffold

# Resume HTML files are in source/ — generated by ../resume/genresume.sh
```

## STRUCTURE

```
Hexo/                          # NOT a git repo (no .git at root)
├── _config.yml                # AUTHORITATIVE site config — theme: next, GA/BA analytics
├── package.json               # Hexo 5.4.2, 12 plugins
├── scaffolds/                 # post/page/draft .md templates (front-matter only)
├── source/                    # Content root (has its own AGENTS.md)
│   ├── _posts/{category}/     # ~125 posts, organized into 16 category subdirs
│   ├── about/ | categories/ | tags/ | search/ | journal/
│   └── image/                 # All images local — no cloud dependency
├── themes/
│   ├── next/                  # ACTIVE — NexT 7.8.0 Mist scheme (installed standalone, no .git)
│   ├── customtheme/           # Previously active EJS theme (still present, not used)
│   ├── old_next/              # Older NexT v5 clone (has its own .git, keep)
│   └── landscape/             # Hexo default (unused, keep)
├── public/                    # Generated output (gitignored)
├── .deploy_git/               # Deploy target — ONLY directory with deploy git history
├── source/.git                # Post content repo (separate: blog-file)
└── .omo/                      # OpenCode session data
```

## FRONT-MATTER (posts)

```yaml
title: "Quoted String"
date: 2017-12-03 21:37:07
categories:
- Android Tree        # Top-level domain (space-separated words)
- Kernel              # Second-level subtopic
tags: [源码分析, MTK]  # List or scalar
```

Key rules:
- `title` is always a quoted string
- `categories`: two-level hierarchy — domain (e.g. `Android Tree`, `Linux Tree`) then subtopic
- `tags`: lowercase single keywords or comma-separated list
- `post_asset_folder: true` in root config — images stored in `source/image/{category}/`
- Image paths use `/image/` prefix in markdown, e.g. `![alt](/image/android/mtk/foo.jpg)`

## ANTI-PATTERNS

- **Prefer NOT to edit `themes/next/` files directly** — NexT is upstream. Override via `source/_data/next.yml`. Small config-only changes (e.g., menu entries) in `themes/next/_config.yml` are OK when no `_data/` dir exists yet.
- **Do NOT touch `public/` or `.deploy_git/`** — generated outputs, both gitignored.
- **Do NOT modify/remove `themes/landscape/`, `themes/old_next/`, or `themes/customtheme/`** — unused but present.
- **Do NOT create flat post lists** — always categorize into subdirectories under `source/_posts/`.
- **Do NOT use Chinese in filenames** — English kebab-case only.
- **Do NOT commit to the root** — there is no git repo at root. Only `.deploy_git/` is a repo.

## RESUME INTEGRATION

Resume is served on both sites:
- **Blog**: `/blog/resume_cn.html` and `/blog/resume_en.html` (HTML in `source/`)
- **Astro**: `/resume_cn.html` and `/resume_en.html` (HTML in `astro/public/`)
- **Nav**: Menu entries added in `themes/next/_config.yml`, `skip_render` in root `_config.yml`

Regenerate after editing `resume/resume_*.md`:
```bash
cd ../../resume && ./genresume.sh [cn|en] [--pdf]
```

## CONFIG QUIRKS

- **Two `_config.yml` files exist**: root (`theme: next`) is authoritative. `source/_config.yml` (`theme: customtheme`, `language: zh-CN`) is legacy/outdated — ignore.
- **Gitalk** is commented out in BOTH root `_config.yml` AND `themes/next/_config.yml` — currently DISABLED. The `themes/next/AGENTS.md` may claim otherwise, but verify against the actual config.
- **Chatra chat** IS enabled in `themes/next/_config.yml` (sidebar chat button).
- **NexT theme** has NO `.git` directory — it's a standalone install (not a submodule). Avoid `git submodule` commands.
- **No `_data/` directory** exists yet — create `source/_data/next.yml` for theme overrides.
- **No root `scripts/` or `languages/` dir** — all extensibility via theme config.
- **`source/` is a separate git repo** (`git@github.com:huaqianlee/blog-file.git`). The root and source have independent version control.
